detail_text: The equipment and cleaning practices used at your firm pose a risk to the sterility of the ISO 5 Laminar Flow Hood in which sterile drugs are produced. Specifically, a) Non-sterile gowns are used during the production of sterile drug products in the ISO 5 Laminar Flow Hood. b) The tubing connected to the stock solutions of [redacted] located in the ISO 5 Laminar Flow Hood are not sanitized between the production of different sterile drug products. On 8/14/18, the Sterile Compounding Technician touched the tubing several times during the production of Ertapenem 500mg/NS 50ml Easy pump and did not sanitize the tubing prior to producing a different drug product. c) Prior to cleaning, sterile wipes were introduced into the IS0-5 area for routine daily cleaning and some of the unused wipes were left for cleaning throughout the remainder of the day. While the wipes were moved for cleaning underneath, they remained open and exposed in the IS0 -5 area prior, during, and following cleaning completion.
